rows.text: first results since its 28-Oct listing: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 510.9 cr, up 22.8%, EBITDA up 42.5% to Rs 126.6 cr, PAT Rs 40.4 cr, 3.3x.

Board authorises four Key Managerial Personnel (MD, Whole Time Director, Group CFO, Company Secretary) to jointly or severally determine the materiality of events and make stock-exchange disclosures -- an internal governance appointment, not a materiality event itself.
